idea.title: Invoicing app for French micro-entrepreneurs with VAT and URSSAF declarations

source.text: A simple invoicing app for French freelancers (auto-entrepreneurs) that handles VAT and URSSAF declarations, 9 EUR a month. Launch country FR, budget 1,000 EUR, 10 hours a week, goal side income, edge: I am a developer. Just go: do not ask questions. Use the slug freelance-invoicing-fr.

idea.problem: French micro-entrepreneurs must issue compliant invoices, track VAT franchise thresholds and declare revenue to URSSAF monthly or quarterly.
idea.solution: A simple invoicing app that also handles VAT and URSSAF declarations
assumptions: No existing audience, list or customers in the niche (not stated; user said 'just go').
No validation done yet (no waitlist, no pre-sales).
Paid search CPC of about EUR 3 per click for French invoicing-software keywords (no sourced French CPC found).
The app would connect to an existing plateforme agréée (PA) for e-invoicing rather than register as one.
Side-income target of about EUR 1,000/month, used for the break-even view.

confidence.note: Several facts come from search snippets; a sourced French CPC and a written PA partner API quote would raise it further.

gross_margin.note: About 84% after Stripe (~0.45 EUR) and PA per-invoice fees (~1 EUR/user/month), estimate.

ltv_cac.note: LTV ~100 EUR vs paid CAC ~460 EUR: LTV:CAC ~0.2, no organic channel to fix it (R4).

pricing_power.note: Abby, Indy, Tiime, Shine invoice for 0 EUR; Abby sells URSSAF filing at the same 9 EUR. Lowered by R4.

build_effort.note: Invoicing MVP 6-10 weeks at 10 h/week, plus URSSAF API approval and PA integration of unknown length.

skills_match.note: Developer: the build is in reach; French tax, e-invoicing and marketing skills are missing.

capital_needed.note: Hosting is cheap, but PA vendor API access is quoted on request (one claim: 2,450 EUR, unverified).

time_to_mvp.note: About 8-10 weeks to a usable product with declarations, if URSSAF grants API access in time.

sales_cycle.note: Self-serve purchase by the freelancer, same day, no committee.

channel_readiness.note: No audience; SEO owned by Abby, Indy, Qonto and comparators; top Facebook groups run by competitors.

search_demand.note: 1.66M economically active micro-entrepreneurs end-2025; 758,600 new ones in 2025.

trend.note: Micro-entreprise creations at a record, +7% in 2024 and +6% in 2025 (INSEE).

willingness_to_pay.note: Free tiers cover invoicing and e-invoicing; paid share of Abby's 150k users is unknown.

free_alternatives.note: Free tools invoice and estimate URSSAF; the URSSAF site files for free. R1 applied.

competitor_density.note: 12+ named tools, 149 registered PAs; Indy raised 86 MEUR and claims 700k users.

differentiation.note: Same job, same price as Abby Start (9 EUR); 'simple' is not a difference. R1 applied.

legal_regulatory.note: From 2027-09 B2B invoices must go through a plateforme agréée; filing for users needs a URSSAF mandate.

platform_dependency.note: Depends on one PA partner and on URSSAF granting restricted API access.

market_risk.note: Invoicing and declarations are a legal, recurring obligation for every active micro-entrepreneur.

skills.note: Strong on building software, no stated track record in French accounting or SaaS growth.

assets.note: No audience, list, data or accountant network stated.

interest.note: Stated goal is side income; no stated domain passion.

rules_applied.effect: competition capped at 1.5: free_alternatives 1, differentiation 1 (developer skill is not a specific edge)
LTV:CAC ~0.2, no channel to fix it: pricing_power 1.5 -> 1, profit 2.17 -> 2.0
no_distribution hit and LTV:CAC < 1: total capped at 49 (already 41)

tam.reasoning: 1.66M economically active micro-entrepreneurs (URSSAF via tpeactu, 2026-07) x 108 EUR/year

sam.reasoning: assumed 52% service sellers: 1.66M x 0.52 = 863k x 108 EUR/year

som.reasoning: 0.1% of SAM for a solo founder in year 1 = ~860 paying users; optimistic given no channel

price.reasoning: founder's stated price; equals Abby Start list price of 9 EUR HT

variable_cost_per_unit.reasoning: Stripe 9 x (1.5% + 0.7% Billing) + 0.25 = 0.45 + PA fees 5 invoices x 0.20 = 1.00

churn_monthly_pct.reasoning: midpoint of 6.8% logo churn and 8.9% MRR churn for 0-10 USD ARPA SaaS; ~2%/month from micro-business closures alone (INSEE 28% 5-year survival)

payback_months.reasoning: 460 / (9 x 0.84 = 7.56 EUR gross profit per month)

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: small VPS ~10 + transactional email ~5 + domain ~1 + misc; not from price pages

break_even_customers_per_month.reasoning: 20 / 7.56 = 2.6 to cover costs; a 1,000 EUR/month side income needs (1000 + 20) / 7.56 = 135 paying users

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: 8 weeks build at 10 h/week + 2 weeks to first paid user; URSSAF API approval may add more

verdict.launch_reason: The product is built around French URSSAF and DGFiP rules; it has no market outside France.

type_checks.note: Monthly churn of 6.8-8.9% for 0-10 USD ARPA SaaS; INSEE: only 28% of micro-entrepreneurs still active after 5 years.
Switching is cheap (numbering just continues), which helps you win users but also lets them leave; bank-bundled invoicing locks some in.

verdict.cheapest_test: 7-day pre-sale of a 79 EUR done-for-you e-invoicing switch (PA account, templates, URSSAF setup) posted in 3 micro-entrepreneur communities; 3 paid pre-sales or stop.
kill_criteria: fewer than 100 landing-page visitors by day 5 -> the channel is dead, stop
fewer than 3 paid pre-sales at 79 EUR by day 7 -> stop
fewer than 10 replies to 40 direct messages by day 6 -> stop

rescue.change: Sell a done-for-you e-invoicing switch service (79 EUR one-off) to micro-entrepreneurs before the 2027-09 deadline, on top of a free PA tool
rescue.why: Fixes ltv_cac and pricing_power: people pay for done-for-you help, not for a 13th invoicing app
rescue.effort: 1 week to test, 1 h per client
rescue.requires: Learning the PA onboarding of 1-2 free tools; posting in communities

rescue.change: Build for one profession the free tools ignore (e.g. trades quotes with deposits and progress invoices) where you can reach a community
rescue.why: Fixes differentiation and channel_readiness, if the niche has a reachable group
rescue.requires: Access to a niche community and a written PA partner API quote

narrative.answer: **NO-GO**. Abby already sells exactly this, invoicing plus URSSAF filing, at **9 EUR/month** to 150,000+ users, and free tools cover the rest. With no channel, every paid customer costs ~460 EUR and returns ~100 EUR.
tldr: The job is solved: free tiers from Abby, Indy, Tiime and Shine handle invoicing and e-invoicing, and Abby charges **9 EUR** for URSSAF filing.
Indy has raised **86 MEUR**, and 149 plateformes agréées compete for the 2027 e-invoicing switch. A solo developer cannot register as one.
Unit economics fail: LTV ~100 EUR against a paid CAC of ~460 EUR (estimates), so LTV:CAC is **0.2**.
narrative.lesson: Being a developer is not an edge when the product is a compliance feature that funded incumbents give away.

key_findings.title: Abby already sells this at 9 EUR
key_findings.detail: Abby Start includes **URSSAF declaration and payment** at 9 EUR HT/month, its free plan covers invoicing and VAT-threshold alerts, and it claims **150,000+** users.

key_findings.title: Funded incumbents give e-invoicing away
key_findings.detail: Indy has raised **86 MEUR** and offers free e-invoicing as a registered PA; Tiime, Shine and Qonto also invoice for **0 EUR**.

key_findings.title: No channel, CAC far above LTV
key_findings.detail: SEO is held by incumbents and comparison sites; at an assumed 3 EUR CPC and 0.65% conversion, CAC is **~460 EUR** against an LTV of **~100 EUR** (estimate).

narrative.recommendation: Do not build the app. Test a 79 EUR done-for-you e-invoicing switch service for 7 days, and stop at fewer than 3 pre-sales.
narrative.steelman: The market is huge and growing (**1.66M** active micro-entrepreneurs, record creations), and the 2027-09 e-invoicing mandate forces all of them to change tools. The evidence: incumbents registered as PAs early and made the switch **free**, so the demand exists but the margin does not.

premortem.cause: Nobody finds the app: SEO and the big Facebook groups belong to Abby, Indy and comparators, and paid clicks cost more than a user ever pays.
premortem.early_signal: Fewer than 100 visitors and 0 paid users in the first 30 days after launch

premortem.cause: Visitors compare and pick a free tier (Indy, Abby, Tiime) over a 9 EUR unknown app doing the same job.
premortem.early_signal: Signup-to-paid below 2% and 'why not free?' objections in the first 20 conversations

premortem.cause: URSSAF API approval or the PA partner contract drags on, and the declarations feature never ships.
premortem.early_signal: No sandbox access 30 days after the URSSAF application; no written PA API quote

changes.what: All businesses must be able to receive e-invoices through a plateforme agréée.
Micro-entreprises, including those under the VAT franchise, must issue e-invoices and e-report.
MPs voted 239-0 to drop the cut of the VAT franchise threshold to 25,000 EUR, removing a VAT-complexity trigger.
Abby is registered as a plateforme agréée.
Indy bought Coover's invoicing software to grow before the reform.

why_now.note: The e-invoicing mandate is a real trigger, but incumbents registered as PAs in 2025-2026 and made it free, so the window has closed.

icp.who: Newly registered service micro-entrepreneur (BNC or BIC services) under the VAT franchise, invoicing B2B clients
where: Facebook group 'La communauté des auto-entrepreneurs' (~61k, run by Portail Auto-Entrepreneur)
icp.pays_for_today: Mostly 0 EUR (Indy, Abby, Tiime, Shine free tiers, URSSAF site); some pay Abby Start 9 EUR HT or Freebe 12.50 EUR HT/month
icp.budget: Average revenue ~1,720 EUR/month, so 9 EUR is ~0.5% of revenue; affordable but anchored at 0
icp.trigger: First invoice, first URSSAF declaration, or the 2027-09 obligation to issue e-invoices

free_alternative.evidence: Abby, Indy, Tiime, Shine, Qonto and Henrri invoice for **0 EUR**; Abby's free plan adds URSSAF estimates and VAT-threshold alerts (2026-11).

strong_competitor.evidence: Indy raised **86 MEUR** and claims 700k users; Abby has 604 Capterra reviews and 150k+ users.

graveyard.evidence: Searched for shut-down French freelancer invoicing apps: found only consolidation (Qonto bought Regate in 2024, Henrri MBO), no closures.

no_distribution.evidence: Search results for 'logiciel facturation auto-entrepreneur' are held by Qonto, Abby, Dougs and comparators; the 2 largest Facebook groups are run by competitors.

costs_eat_margin.evidence: Stripe takes ~0.45 EUR on 9 EUR and PA fees run 0.20-0.50 EUR per invoice: gross margin ~84% (estimate), clear.

weak_demand.evidence: Micro-entreprise creations hit a record 758,600 in 2025 (+6%); 1.66M were economically active at end-2025. Clear.

legal_platform_risk.evidence: From 2027-09, B2B e-invoices must go through a DGFiP-registered PA; URSSAF filing needs restricted API access and user mandates.

saturated_wave.evidence: Found 2 near-identical launches in 12 months (fiftie 2026-02, Facturons), both with almost no traction; below the 10 threshold.

customer.pain: Compliant invoices, URSSAF declarations each month or quarter, VAT-threshold tracking, and the 2027 e-invoicing switch
customer.today: Free tiers of Indy, Abby, Tiime or Shine, a bank's invoicing (Qonto), Word or Excel, and the free URSSAF site
